verdict.rationale: CrewAI's API reference documents a POST /resume endpoint to "Resume crew execution with human feedback". That is a direct first-party mechanism for continuing a run with a human's decision, but it is a single index-level mention on the deployed-crew API. A competitor founder's claim that CrewAI lacks pause hooks is positioning, not a concrete hands-on failure, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: documentation of how a run pauses mid-execution for input or approval, approve/reject semantics, how the human decision feeds back into the agent, open-source framework coverage beyond the deployed API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pause an agent mid-run for human input or approval and resume with the human's decision

citations.quote: POST /resume](https://docs.crewai.com/v1.15.23/en/api-reference/resume.md): Resume crew execution with human feedback
